rows.summary: Prompt for agents: make web fonts load faster without changing how anything looks, shrink font bytes as far as possible, keep rendering identical, prove it with before/after pixel diff.
rows.why: AIO already serves Pretendard v1.3.9 as unicode-range dynamic subsets (P1756, the single file was 2 MB) and keeps the system Korean font on save-data/2g/3g (first-users F01).
